title: File Paths
sourceHint: Use Copy Path in your file manager, then paste the path text. File-manager clipboard metadata is not read here.
format.name: File name
baseHint: Required for relative paths. Enter the directory you want to resolve from; no project or working directory is assumed.
lexicalHint: String conversion only: no file access, existence checks, shell expansion or symlink resolution. Relative output uses /; Windows comparison ignores case. For //server/share or relative Windows paths, choose Windows.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Your source and output are preserved; try again.
error.invalid: Invalid path or file URI. Use one unquoted path per line, without blank lines or control characters. URI query, fragment and encoded separators are unsupported.
error.absolute: This operation needs an absolute path. Windows drive-relative and drive-less rooted paths are ambiguous; include the drive or UNC share.
error.base: Enter an absolute base directory to create relative paths.
error.root: Relative paths require the same path syntax and root (Unix root, Windows drive, or UNC share).
error.limit: Input is too large: at most 1,048,576 characters, 10,000 paths, and a 32,768-character base. Nothing was truncated.
